body:
`ConditionBuilder` hands `CelPredicateField` a **literal, unconditional** placeholder that teaches a root the same component has already stopped offering at that mount. Seat-verified at source on `origin/main` `00c4df509`:

```tsx
:195  export const RECORD_CONDITION_ROOTS = ['record', 'previous'];      // what objectui#9645 narrowed the autocomplete to
…
:479            placeholder="record.status != 'done' && user.isAdmin"    // the SAME TEXT at every mount
```

⭐ Control in the same command: `roots` occurs on **16** lines of that file ⇒ the instrument reads it, and the placeholder's absence from that machinery is a reading, ⛔ not a failed search.

⇒ **the internal contradiction, inside one component**: at a `scope="record"` mount, PR objectui#9854 (card objectui#9645) deliberately narrowed the autocomplete so `user` is **no longer OFFERED** — while the placeholder three hundred lines away still **TEACHES** `user.isAdmin` there. The placeholder is ⛔ not parameterised by `scope` at all.

## ⭐ A fact this seat measured that makes it worse than 「an unoffered root」

At a **server-evaluated** mount the taught root is not merely unadvertised, it is **unbound**. Measured by this seat at source on objectstack `origin/main` `07c6f82`, `packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts:253`–`:268`, verbatim:

> The condition formula is evaluated against **two bindings** … `record` — the record-shaped view built by `pickRecordPayload` … `previous` — the record's pre-write state, built by `pickPreviousPayload`

⇒ no `user`, no `org`. A condition copied from this placeholder into a hook condition reads a root the evaluator never binds.

## Class (c), and why it is the THIRD door of one trap

objectui#9645 closed the **autocomplete** door; objectui#9855 closed the **subject dropdown** door (`org.id`, landed in PR objectui#9949). This is the **placeholder** door — a different control from either, and the one an author reads before typing anything. ⛔ Not fixed in objectui#9855: it is outside that card's declared surface, and its dev reported it rather than widening.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that `user.isAdmin` is wrong **everywhere**: the objectui#9855 dev measured that `user` IS in the engine's `SCOPE_ROOTS`, lints `ok:true`, and IS bound by `buildExpressionScope` at every **client-evaluated** mount. The placeholder is right there and wrong at the server-evaluated ones — which is exactly what 「one literal at every mount」 cannot express.
- ⛔ Not a proposal for the fix's shape (parameterise by scope, take the example from the mount's own declared subjects, or drop the second clause). That is the claiming seat's measurement.
